stem: What is implied in lines 57 through 62 of the poem “Sybil Ludington’s Ride”?

options.label: F
options.text: Future generations will remember Sybil’s deed.

options.label: G
options.text: Sybil expects to be rewarded for her bravery.

options.label: H
options.text: Sybil is fearful while riding in the dark.
